title: Blink
summary: Turn the built-in D13 LED on and off every half second.
learningObjectives: Configure a pin as an OUTPUT with pinMode().
Drive a pin HIGH and LOW with digitalWrite().
expectedBehavior: The built-in LED (labeled L, driven by D13) alternates on/off every 500 ms.
wiringChecklist: No external wiring is required — the D13 LED is already on the board.
predictPrompt: How many times will the LED turn on in 10 seconds?
observePrompt: Watch the built-in LED. Does it match your prediction?
tryNext: Change both delay values to 100 and predict the new blink rate.
